race.description: Steeline Riverstone Dogs Only Final F
race.comment: PAY IT FORWARD (5) has a strong record this track and trip including two wins from three starts. Missed the frame latest (17.76) when fourth over 324m at this track in a Grade 5. Looks suited and should go close. KID KERMARO (2) has a fair record and proved too classy last time to win by 1.5 lengths at this track in a handy 17.51 beating MR. CHILLI. Recorded one of the quickest times on the card in scoring last start. Leading player again. MR. CHILLI (6) recorded his best time this course and distance latest, finishing a 1.5 lengths second behind KID KERMARO in 17.61. Rates a leading chance if runs up to latest. REALLY SAVAGE (1) is a last start winner worth following up. Something for the Multiples: DESPICABLE PEDRO (3)
